name: GDI Intake Valve Cleaner

features.text: Will not harm oxygen sensors or catalytic converters when used as instructed.

description: A powerful blend of solvents and detergents that quickly dissolves heavy deposits that accumulate on the intake valves, ports and combustion chambers of gasoline direct inject (GDI) engines. GDI engine are prone to rapid deposit buildup due to the placement of the injectors and design of the intake system. GDI Intake Valve Cleaner is specially formulated to withstand intake temperatures and ensure maximum potency at the points of cleaning. When applied with customized equipment and adaptors, this advanced formula can restore lost power, fuel economy and performance. For enhanced cleaning, use in conjunction with #16501 Optimizer.
application: Vehicle should be at operating temperature. Recommended Method: Follow instructions for use with #73400 EDR-3 Fuel Machine. Alternate Method: 1) Attach #74100 A.I.S. Tool to Air-Intake System at throttle body opening. 2) Pour GDI Air Intake Cleaner into canister of #72480 Deluxe Cleaner Application Tool II. 3) Attach outlet hose of Cleaner Application Tool to A.I.S. Tool. 4) Follow instructions for use with #72480 Deluxe Cleaner Application Tool II.
